name: Thrilla in Vanilla
note: Toothsome menu confirms $19 shake = vanilla ice cream + vanilla pastry cream + vanilla wafers + macaron + whipped topping + cherry. No official nutrition; modeled as ~20oz premium vanilla shake (Sonic large vanilla ~930 cal/105g carbs analog) plus wafers/macaron/pastry cream toppings. Keyword 38g is a single-serving error; full shake as sold is ~130g carbs.

name: Santa Hat Brownie Sundae
note: DFB review (Plaza Ice Cream Parlor, $7.99, Very Merry Christmas Party): brownie + vanilla ice cream + hot fudge + crushed peppermint + whipped cream + red velvet cone with marshmallow; reviewers call it 'a lot'. Component build: brownie ~56g C, scoop ~30g C, fudge ~22g C, cone/peppermint/marshmallow ~20g C. Low end of prior range (60g) implausible for this build.

name: Two Foot Dog
note: Official description: 24-inch Vienna all-beef frankfurter on a baguette with 2 toppings ($20.99 base; fries are a separate combo upcharge, excluded here). Carbs driven by the ~24in baguette (~230g bread, ~117g carbs) + toppings; dog itself ~10oz all-beef frank (~810 cal, near-zero carbs). Sodium is genuinely extreme (frank + baguette).

name: Whole Cheese Pizza
note: Louie's/Cafe 4 menu: Whole Cheese Pizza $38.99 vs Jumbo Cheese Slice $11.29 — this is a full-size sharing pie (~16in, ~8 slices), NOT a personal pizza; prior 70-96g range is roughly one jumbo slice. Modeled on large NY-style cheese pie (Domino's large cheese 8x290 cal analog). Exact diameter not published, hence 45.

name: Indian-Style Bread Service (with 3 accompaniments)
note: Sanaa basket = 5 large flatbreads (traditional/garlic-ginger/spiced naan, onion kulcha, paneer paratha) — 'shareable between one and five people'; 3-accompaniment version is same breads with 3 dips (~2oz each, incl. sugary chutneys). Bread: 5 x ~90g naan (262 cal/45g carbs each per USDA-style data) + dips ~20g carbs. As sold for the table: ~230g carbs; prior 100g low end covers only ~2 breads.
